# NpcPry

NPCs that path through doors by prying (`NavPry`) give up on a door after three pry starts within 30 seconds and
leave it alone for a minute, so a door they can never open no longer costs a pry attempt every tick.
`TryNotePryAttempt` in `NPCSteeringSystem.Pry.cs` holds the rule; `WFNpcPryMemoryComponent` stores the count.

Pries by entities with no player attached are no longer written to the admin log.
